#### How to read this dashboard

Live health of the XOXNO Lending protocol on Stellar: oracle prices, market sizes, rates, and risk parameters, read directly from the chain. “Now” for staleness is the **ledger close time**.

🟢 healthy · 🟠 warning · 🔴 needs attention — hover any panel’s ⓘ for what it shows and when it turns red.

**Sections:** Health · Protocol · Markets · Oracles · Spokes · Exporter

panels.title: Oracle health
panels.description: Worst oracle across all assets. Red means at least one asset price is not safe to use.

panels.title: Min freshness (time to stale)
panels.description: Smallest remaining time before any asset price becomes stale, measured at ledger close time.

panels.title: Any stale flag
panels.description: 1 if any asset price is currently older than its allowed maximum age.

panels.title: Any deviation flag
panels.description: 1 if any asset price currently deviates beyond its tolerance band.

panels.title: Exporter — last scrape age
panels.description: Age of the last successful on-chain read. If this is red, everything else on the page may be out of date.

panels.title: TVL
panels.description: Total value supplied to the protocol, in USD.

panels.title: Total borrowed
panels.description: Total value borrowed from the protocol, in USD.

panels.title: Available liquidity
panels.description: Supplied minus borrowed — what can still be withdrawn or borrowed, in USD.

panels.title: Revenue
panels.description: Accumulated protocol revenue, in USD.

panels.title: TVL / borrowed / liquidity — trend
panels.description: Protocol totals over time, in USD. The gap between TVL and borrowed is the available liquidity.

panels.title: Market grid
panels.description: One row per market: size, rates, utilization, and accrual freshness.

panels.title: Supplied vs borrowed (USD) by market
panels.description: Total supplied and borrowed per market over time, in USD.

panels.title: Available liquidity (USD) by market
panels.description: Withdrawable liquidity per market over time, in USD.

panels.title: Utilization by market
panels.description: Borrowed share of supplied funds per market. High utilization means withdrawals may have to wait.

panels.title: Supplied quantity by market (tokens)
panels.description: Amount supplied per market in native token units (log scale — assets differ by orders of magnitude).

panels.title: Borrowed quantity by market (tokens)
panels.description: Amount borrowed per market in native token units (log scale).

panels.title: Oracle price (USD)
panels.description: The USD price the protocol uses for each asset (log scale).

panels.title: Deviation vs tolerance band (bps)
panels.description: Primary-vs-anchor price gap per asset (solid), against that asset's own tolerance band (dashed). A solid line crossing its dashed line means the deviation flag raises.

panels.title: Freshness (seconds until stale)
panels.description: Time left before each asset price goes stale. Negative or zero means stale now.

panels.title: Oracle status by asset
panels.description: Per-asset snapshot: the three oracle prices, deviation, and the oracle flags. The single place to see why an asset is flagged.

panels.title: Oracle health timeline
panels.description: One row per asset: green while the price is safe to use, red while it is failing. See the status table above for whether a red patch was staleness or deviation.

panels.title: Oracle configuration by asset
panels.description: How each asset's oracle is configured: blend strategy, maximum allowed price age, tolerance band, and sanity bounds — plus its current freshness.

panels.title: All spoke listings — operational state
panels.description: Every listed spoke-asset and its operational switches. “Closed” means the cap is 0 — the market accepts no new supply or borrows.

panels.title: Liquidation settings by spoke
panels.description: Per-spoke liquidation settings: the health factor a liquidation aims to restore, the HF at which the maximum bonus applies, and the bonus scaling factor.

panels.title: Risk parameters & caps by asset
panels.description: Per-asset risk settings across all spokes: how much you can borrow against each asset (LTV), when liquidation starts, liquidation bonus and fee, and how full the caps are.

panels.title: Supply cap utilization by spoke-asset
panels.description: Supply amount as a share of the supply cap. Red means the cap is nearly exhausted.

panels.title: Borrow cap utilization by spoke-asset
panels.description: Borrow amount as a share of the borrow cap. Red means the cap is nearly exhausted.

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description: How long one full on-chain read takes.

panels.title: View failures (rate / 5m)
panels.description: On-chain view calls that failed, by view and error code.

panels.title: Ledger skew (ledger - wall clock)
panels.description: Difference between ledger close time and wall clock. Large skew delays staleness detection.

panels.title: Lending alerts
panels.description: Imported rules carry no dashboard/panel link, so no panel above shows alert state. This lists them instead.

panels.title: Oracle staleness budget (effective max_stale)
panels.description: Denominator of LendingOracleFreshnessHalfConsumed/Critical. Without it those alerts fire as a bare ratio with nothing to compare against.

panels.title: RPC errors
panels.description: What LendingRpcErrors fires on.

panels.title: Time since last accrual
panels.description: What LendingAccrualStalled fires on.

panels.title: Exporters by self-reported network
panels.description: One series per exporter process, labelled by the network it claims. Two series on one network, or a network missing entirely, is what LendingExporterNetworkMismatch/Missing catch.

panels.title: Deprecated spoke-assets
panels.description: What LendingSpokeDeprecated fires on. A deprecated spoke-asset still holds positions that must wind down.
